name: Cressanda Railway Solutions Ltd
about:

and Services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
CRSL is doing business in the Railway Concierge service sector. It specializes in providing 
 information technology, digital media, and IT-enabled services.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend

Company has high debtors of 1,606 days.
Working capital days have increased from 696 days to 1,606 days
